text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rare day off.
I went to the shopping mall to pick up some daily necessities, and then—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Waaah, waaah.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, you were scared, weren't you?
But it's okay now, you're safe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hold on. Just... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Just in time.
I think this little girl might be lost.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: She was huddled up crying all by herself in the corner, so I tried talking to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: *hic*, *hic*...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there. It must have been scary all on your own.
Good girl...
choice_data_list: Aren't your mom or dad with you?
Are you separated from your mom or dad?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
choice_data_list: Did you get separated from them?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *hic*... I don't kno— Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was just starting to calm down, but now she's crying again...!
Large tears roll down her cheeks one after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull a handkerchief from my pocket
and gently wipe away her tears.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *hic*...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, all clean. Good for you.
So... were you shopping today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The little girl gave a small nod...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see~. Was there something you wanted to buy?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...The magical girl wand... from Uma Witch...
Mom and Dad said... they'd buy it for me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How nice~. You must have been so excited.
So did you come shopping with your mommy and daddy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl nodded once more. She really had gotten separated from them.
At a time like this, what can I do...?
choice_data_list: I'll head to the lost and found center!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I'll wait here with her, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the lost children's center, a pale, panicked couple was already there.
They appeared to be the little girl's parents...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much for today.
I'm so glad she was able to reunite with her parents...
choice_data_list: I wasn't much help, was I...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, having you there helped me so much.
Hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's not good to walk around leading a lost child away on your own,
so I knew I had to call someone, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There weren't any store clerks or anyone nearby who could help.
To be honest... I was quite at a loss for what to do.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having you rush over right at that moment...
I was truly so happy to see you.
choice_data_list: But I ended up making her cry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems we still have a bit
to learn about children's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even so... because you were with me,
I felt completely at ease.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You were truly wonderful today, Trainer.
Don't ever say you weren't helpful.
choice_data_list: Have I become a Trainer you can rely on?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Of course you have!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides... you've learned to carry a handkerchief properly now.
Good job, such a good child♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you figure it out? Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems my dynamic with Super Creek hasn't changed just yet.
Still, today proved that her trust in me has grown by leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: (...You were truly so dependable today, Trainer.)
